mapper.update:
merge into t_cx_machine_info a USING (
select #{MACHINE.machineCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} machine_code, #{MACHINE.machineName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} machine_name, #{MACHINE.type,jdbcType=VARCHAR} type, #{MACHINE.dimensionMiniMum,jdbcType=DECIMAL} dimension_minimum, #{MACHINE.dimensionMaxiMum,jdbcType=DECIMAL} dimension_maximum, #{MACHINE.quata,jdbcType=DECIMAL} quata, #{MACHINE.quotaRatio,jdbcType=DECIMAL} quota_ratio, #{MACHINE.classShift,jdbcType=VARCHAR} class_shift, #{MACHINE.openMachineClass1,jdbcType=VARCHAR} open_machine_class1, #{MACHINE.openMachineClass2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} open_machine_class2, #{MACHINE.openMachineClass3,jdbcType=VARCHAR} open_machine_class3, #{MACHINE.operatorQty,jdbcType=DECIMAL} operator_qty, #{MACHINE.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} status, #{MACHINE.machineType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} MACHINE_TYPE,
#{MACHINE.createBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} create_by, #{MACHINE.createTime,jdbcType=DATE} create_time, #{MACHINE.updateBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} update_by, #{MACHINE.updateTime,jdbcType=DATE} update_time, #{MACHINE.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} remark from dual
) b ON (a.machine_code = b.machine_code and a.del_flag = '0') WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
a.machine_name = b.machine_name, a.type = b.type, a.dimension_minimum = b.dimension_minimum, a.dimension_maximum = b.dimension_maximum, a.quata = b.quata, a.quota_ratio=b.quota_ratio, a.class_shift = b.class_shift, a.open_machine_class1 = b.open_machine_class1, a.open_machine_class2 = b.open_machine_class2, a.open_machine_class3 = b.open_machine_class3, a.operator_qty = b.operator_qty, a.status = b.status, a.MACHINE_TYPE = b.MACHINE_TYPE,
a.update_by = b.create_by, a.update_time = sysdate, a.remark = b.remark WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( a.id , a.machine_code, a.machine_name, a.type , a.dimension_minimum , a.dimension_maximum , a.quata , a.quota_ratio, a.class_shift , a.open_machine_class1 , a.open_machine_class2 , a.open_machine_class3 , a.operator_qty , a.status , a.MACHINE_TYPE ,
a.create_by , a.create_time , a.remark, a.del_flag ) values (SEQ_PUBLIC.NEXTVAL, b.machine_code, b.machine_name, b.type , b.dimension_minimum , b.dimension_maximum , b.quata , b.quota_ratio, b.class_shift , b.open_machine_class1 , b.open_machine_class2 , b.open_machine_class3 , b.operator_qty , b.status , b.MACHINE_TYPE ,
b.create_by, sysdate, b.remark, '0' )
